finding_summary: FDB-v3 is useful as a research/falsifier donor because it combines natural disfluency, multi-step tool use and explicit state-rollback cases.
Pinned benchmark metadata reports 21 state-rollback scenarios and zero multilingual scenarios, so it grants no German acceptance evidence.
The released inference path is provider/LiveKit oriented and is not an admissible fully-local F2 acceptance runtime as-is.
The donor license is CC-BY-NC-4.0; no donor audio/scenario text was copied into F2 product fixtures.

Trigger4 received a bounded request for original German deterministic fixtures with mock tools, no external model/ASR/TTS/judge calls and a stop rule if no new information appears beyond existing HF/WP715 coverage.
next_exact_action: F2 Trigger4 reviews overlap and executes only the smallest orthogonal original-German pilot through existing admitted VPS/controller authority; this mirror observes provenance and mints no authority.
